title: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for presenters in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
description: Presenters can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings. This feature enables seamless live presentations.
